title: Flood Preparedness: Before the Flood
instructions: Keep disaster emergency kit ready with battery torch, radio, first-aid, dry rations, and bottled water.
Check drainage channels and stormwater exits near your house.
Safeguard important documents, deeds, and identification papers in waterproof bags.
Know the nearest safe municipal relief shelter and evacuation route.

title: Flood Safety: During the Flood
instructions: Turn off electricity main switch and cooking gas cylinders immediately.
Do not walk or drive through flowing water; 15 cm of moving water can knock you down.
Move to higher ground or upper floors of concrete buildings.
Drink only boiled or chlorine-purified water to prevent waterborne disease outbreak.

title: Flood Recovery: After the Flood
instructions: Do not enter flooded homes until authorities confirm structural safety.
Beware of snapped power lines, loose cables, and submerged reptiles.
Disinfect all flooded surfaces and dispose of contaminated food.
Report road blockages and stranded individuals via the Citizen Portal.

title: Earthquake Safety: Drop, Cover, and Hold
instructions: DROP down onto your hands and knees.
COVER your head and neck underneath a sturdy table or desk.
HOLD ON until shaking stops completely.
Stay away from glass windows, exterior walls, and tall furniture.
